theta.source: Sensitivity variant of the ETH production theta: only theta.w changed from 0 to 1/2 (pi kept at 422/740). w is not constrained by the data (shape statistic is a different estimand); 1/2 is the midpoint of the [0, 1] range assumed in logit_train.w_hi. All other fields, including seed_root, are identical to eth.json, so adopter sampling stays paired with the baseline by replicate.

logit_train.source: Training ranges: Wilson 95% intervals at 4 decimals, of pi and of s at tail unit 10D = 0.01 ETH; w_hi over its full [0, 1] as a range assumption (not a measured Wilson set); 60 paths and l2 = 0.001 as in the stablecoin runs. Filled from the ETH theta once production-ready.
